chapter: 16 DCMR chapter 4 — Towing Service for Motor Vehicles
currencyVerified: Verified against dcregs.dc.gov on 2026-09-07 across 15 sections. § 406 shows one rulemaking on record (R0028747, 52 DCR 522). The sole amendment anywhere in the chapter is § 405 (storage lots), 56 DCR 3093, April 24, 2009. See docs/FINDING_2026-09-07_p1t1-trespass-tow-authority.md.

definitions.plain: A tow you did not consent to — including a tow from a private lot. This is the definition the whole thing turns on.

duties.heading: PUBLIC TOWS
duties.plain: They needed a citation. A car cannot be towed from private property without your consent unless a police officer or parking enforcement official issued it a ticket, or a police officer directed the tow in an emergency. A landlord, property manager or lot owner cannot authorize it on their own.

duties.heading: PUBLIC TOWS
duties.plain: They needed a control number from DPW before touching the car. In an emergency they still have to get one within two hours.

duties.heading: PAYMENT FOR SERVICES
duties.plain: If they have hooked your car up but have not driven off yet, you can ask them to stop — and they have to, once you pay the rate set for a discontinued tow. If a police officer or other official ordered the tow and is still on the scene, it takes their agreement too.

duties.heading: PAYMENT FOR SERVICES
duties.plain: Ask for the control number when you collect the car — they must give it to you, along with the legal authority for the tow, an itemized statement, a receipt, and a copy of the Owner’s Bill of Rights.

duties.heading: PAYMENT FOR SERVICES
duties.plain: Storage is capped at $20 per 24 hours, or part of one.

duties.heading: PAYMENT FOR SERVICES
duties.plain: A standard tow of an ordinary car within DC is capped at $100. This cap applies because a tow you did not consent to is a public tow — the company’s own advertised rates do not govern it.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: Charging more than the capped rate for a public tow is itself unlawful. (The prohibition is § 410.12; the infraction schedule classes the same conduct under § 408.1 — charging public-tow rates above the Director’s schedule.)

duties.heading: PUBLIC TOWS
duties.plain: Before the tow, the company had to give DPW the ticket number and the reason — so there is a record of whether a citation ever existed.

duties.heading: PUBLIC TOWS
duties.plain: The government is supposed to notify the registered owner of the tow and where the car is.

duties.heading: PAYMENT FOR SERVICES
duties.plain: They must take cards. Cash, insurance draft, certified check, bank check, money order and at least two major credit cards — cash-only is a violation.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: They cannot refuse you an itemized receipt.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: You can inspect the car before you pay and before it is released. Refusing that is a violation.

duties.heading: PAYMENT FOR SERVICES
duties.plain: Once you show ID and proof of ownership and pay what is genuinely owed, they must release the car promptly, unless the government has placed a hold on it.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: They cannot make you sign up for repairs as a condition of towing your car.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: If they tow your car to their own repair shop, they can only charge one towing fee.

duties.heading: INSPECTIONS AUTHORIZED
duties.plain: Every record of your tow must be kept for three years, and handed to the regulator within one hour of a lawful demand.

duties.heading: REQUIRED TOW TRUCK EQUIPMENT AND MARKINGS
duties.plain: The trade name, address and phone number must be on both cab doors in lettering at least 3 inches high.

duties.heading: REQUIRED TOW TRUCK EQUIPMENT AND MARKINGS
duties.plain: The company’s minimum and maximum fees must be painted on both sides of the truck in lettering at least 2 inches high. (These are the rates for tows you request — a tow you did not consent to is capped separately, and lower.)

duties.heading: REQUIRED TOW TRUCK EQUIPMENT AND MARKINGS
duties.plain: Every tow truck carries a unique ID issued by the regulator, on both sides, at least 1 inch high. Photograph it.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: A tow truck cannot stop at a crash and offer to tow you unless you called them or DPW sent them.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: After a reportable crash they cannot move your car until police authorize it, except to free someone trapped or in a life-threatening situation.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: Carrying a scanner tuned to police frequencies is flatly unlawful. This is the rule against chasing crashes.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: Operating a towing business or a storage lot without a license is unlawful, and can carry arrest as well as a fine.

duties.heading: PROHIBITED ACTS
duties.plain: They must carry at least $750,000 of liability insurance to tow in the District.
